title: Erdős #19 OQ: Explicit EFL Threshold Bounds
description: What is the explicit threshold N such that the Kang-Kelly-Kühn-Methuku-Osthus (2021) proof of the Erdős-Faber-Lovász conjecture holds for all n ≥ N? The absorbing method gives very large implicit constants. Formalizes EFL families, union graphs, and basic structural properties.

sections.title: Background Definitions
sections.summary: Self-contained definitions for simple graphs, proper coloring, k-colorability, complete graphs, EFL families (n edge-disjoint K_n's), and the union graph.
sections.mathContext: An EFL family consists of n copies of $K_n$ sharing at most one vertex pairwise. The union graph has adjacency: $x \sim y$ iff they share a clique.

sections.title: The Explicit Bound Question
sections.summary: Formalizes the EFL conjecture per-n, the asymptotic theorem (axiomatized), and the explicit bound question: is N ≤ 10^7?
sections.mathContext: The 2021 proof shows $\exists N$ such that EFL holds for all $n \geq N$. The open question asks for the smallest such $N$.

sections.title: Basic Structural Results
sections.summary: PROVES: K_n is n-colorable, clique adjacency, shared vertex uniqueness, vertex-clique membership bound, colorability monotonicity, EFL for n=1.
sections.mathContext: Structural facts about EFL families: each vertex in $\leq n$ cliques, distinct cliques share $\leq 1$ vertex, colorability is monotone in the number of colors.

overview.problemStatement: What is the explicit threshold N such that the Erdős-Faber-Lovász conjecture (any union of n edge-disjoint K_n's is n-colorable) holds for all n ≥ N via the Kang-Kelly-Kühn-Methuku-Osthus proof?
overview.text: The EFL conjecture was proved for sufficiently large n in 2021 using the absorbing method, but no explicit threshold N is published. This formalizes the question and proves basic structural properties of EFL families.
